M1 tube preamp Correct Sound Bass Distortion Tube Dimensions 144 mm wide 120 mm high Current Draw 1000 mA / 12 V AC Price $270 This Pedal is currently available. MG ID: 33335 Correct Sound M1 tube preamp M1 tube preamp is designed and built on two ECC83 S (12ax7) tubes. In fact it is evolution of our pedal MT preamp. New preamp has got two channel - #1 (clean) & #2 (dist). Preamp has the first and last cascades like MT and the middle cascade of its own design.
